whatever i am isn't good enough. whatever i am can't check the boxes
constantly fed images and standards of what i'm *supposed* to be, every day of my life, everywhere i go
the other day i saw this gym bunny walk down the street
absolute perfect specimen in impeccable clothes and a tight vest. you could have bounced a golden groat off that ass and gotten back two silvers and a bronzie
every inch of them dripping in class. status. confidence. money. their wristwatch probably cost more than what i'd make in a year
sol above i wanted them so badly. wanted to BE them so badly...
that's what i mean
"look like this" "act like this" "feel like this" "BE THIS" or you are WORTHLESS

trying to be what they want feels so wrong. and even if it didn't? it'd be pointless... i know i'll fail... but not trying? ... lua, the loneliness feels like a crushing weight that makes it so it's hard to get out of bed some days
